description:
List the most recent filings of ONE listed company: title, date, a direct link to the source PDF, and — where we have it — the structured extraction that filing produced. Call this to answer 'what has this company filed lately' and 'give me the original document', which is what most callers actually want before any analysis.

This is the widest view we offer: it covers EVERY filing we hold for the company, not just the ones we extract.

Do NOT use it to ask what a case or a plan currently amounts to — it returns documents in date order, not folded state; get_entity_state does that. Do NOT use it to sweep the market for one filing type across companies (scan_recent_events), and do NOT page through it for bulk export: it has no cursor and stops at 50 rows per call.

Read with_extraction: most filings have none, because we extract a focused set of filing types — call list_coverage for the ones we support today. `extraction: null` means we have not extracted that filing — it never means the filing is unimportant. When extraction is present, pass its aevt_ to get_event_with_context for the full case timeline.

Titles are returned in the original Chinese, unchanged — translating a filing title would be rewriting the fact. There is no cursor: this is a recent-filings view, not a bulk export.

`published_at` is null for most filings: it is present only when the source itself supplied a timestamp, and we do not substitute our own collection time for it. Use ann_date, which is always present, for the filing date.

market.description: Which exchange the ticker belongs to.
market.title: Market

name: list_company_filings

FilingEntry.description:
一份公告。🔴 **把内层字段声明出来，别让 `filings` 退化成裸 `object`**
（2026-08-21 评审逮到：原来生成的 schema 是 `{"type":"object","additionalProperties":true}`，
六个字段一个都不可机器读 —— 而本仓自己的原则是「判别式要机器可校验，不能只活在描述里」，
见 2.21 §5.5）。
⚠️ 仍然 `extra="allow"` 且字段有默认值：schema 的作用是让调用方**能读懂**，
不是当"新增一个字段就把响应打回"的闸门（同 `_Base` 上方的注释）。

aann_.description: Opaque filing id, present only once the filing has been parsed.
aann_.title: Aann

extraction.description: Single compatibility representative {aevt_, event_type, phase}, or null when no event was extracted. Use extractions for the complete list. Null never means the filing is unimportant.
extraction.title: Extraction

extractions.description: Complete list of extracted events: [{aevt_, event_type, phase}, ...]. Empty means no extracted events are available for this filing; it does not mean the filing is unimportant.
extractions.title: Extractions

published_at.description: Null for most filings: present only when the source itself supplied a timestamp. We never substitute our own collection time. Use ann_date.
published_at.title: Published At

sources.description: Every source we hold this filing from, best first: {source, pdf_url, page_url}. More than one means more than one way to open the original.
sources.title: Sources

title.description: Original Chinese title, with the stock-name prefix that some sources prepend removed. Never translated.
title.title: Title

FilingEntry.title: FilingEntry

outputSchema.description: Recent filings of one listed company, with source links and any extraction.

filings.description: Newest first. One entry per filing, already merged across the five sources it may appear in; `sources` lists every link we hold for it.
filings.title: Filings

found.description: False means we have no such security on file at all — not that it filed nothing. Check this before reading filings.
found.title: Found

more_available.description: True when older filings exist beyond what came back. There is no cursor; this tool is a recent-filings view, not a bulk export.
more_available.title: More Available

with_extraction.description: How many of the returned filings carry structured extraction. This is normally a small fraction — call list_coverage for the filing types we support today. A zero here means 'not extracted yet', never 'nothing happened'.
with_extraction.title: With Extraction

outputSchema.title: FilingsResult
